items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC12 of the mini-plan each have a test or E2E step.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Route maps missing/refused/EISDIR/EPERM to missing; UI has loading, error and empty states.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Strict id regex, realpath+relative equality, handle regular-file check, read-only.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Server route/tail/symlink tests, tree model, dock/window component tests, real-browser E2E.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No timer; 1 MiB positional window; event-driven rescan only on subrunner card change.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Files under 300 lines; extends existing feed card/subrunner reducer.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer Claude subagent JSONL -> route -> BubbleTranscript consumer proven by E2E round trip.

items.name: Motion/A11y
items.note: Entrance gated to no-preference; 44px targets on coarse; Radix focus trap and return.
